member.name: T:Manilal_V5NG.SafeContractResolver
member.summary: Overrides DefaultContractResolver to prevent the "Invalid type owner for DynamicMethod" crash that occurs when Newtonsoft.Json tries to call GetDefaultCreator on a raw T[] type. Arrays cannot own DynamicMethods in .NET Framework — they don't have constructors anyway. This resolver catches that specific crash and safely initialises the array contract manually.
